scientific_question: does the frozen label-blind K3-witness / projected-K4 / proof-safe multi-witness pairwise certificate recover unseen four-stage Pythia chronologies without false pairwise exclusions?
pre_confirmation_label_blind_audit: completed before any heldout codebook generation; both pair orientations must be tested without access to the target chronology label
target_selection_rule: four rotations of ABCD plus four rotations of its reverse; fixed before any heldout codebook generation; each stage appears exactly twice in every chronology position within each seed
witness_definition: for each target and each candidate final-stage class j, use only the K3 basis and that target endpoint to form the six static K3 class predictions, compute their convex projection, and set u_j=(target-p_j)/||target-p_j||; all 32 witnesses for a seed are frozen before any degree-four active-lift transition for that seed
degree4_tensor_retention: forbidden; exact degree-four endpoints may exist only transiently long enough to hash/check/project, then must be discarded
certificate_form: for each target and unordered pair {i,j}, solve the proof-safe infinity-norm multi-witness local-order LP for both i<j and j<i; infer an orientation only when exactly one class has corrected Euclidean-distance lower bound above 1e-6
label_blind_decision_rule: the solver receives only the two stage names and the target-derived witness/projection objectives, never the frozen true history label; exactly one excluded orientation implies the opposite orientation, neither excluded implies ambiguity, both excluded is invalid
full_chronology_rule: a chronology is returned only when all six unordered pairs are certified and the inferred orientations form a single transitive total order; otherwise abstain
evaluation_rule: only after the label-blind chronology output is fixed, compare it and the inferred pair orientations with the preregistered target history for accuracy/false-exclusion reporting
hard_invalidity_rule: both orientations excluded for any pair, any inferred orientation contradicts the exact generating target, any exact target replay or projected-Mobius check fails, any method/protocol/hash/stage-count gate drifts, or any corrected lower bound exceeds its exact terminal witness-space benchmark beyond tolerance
primary_metric: number of fully certified target chronologies out of 32
secondary_metrics: number of certified pair orientations out of 192
number of inferred pair orientations contradicting the generating target
minimum and distribution of corrected excluded-class margins
stage executions and retained K4 scalar count

interpretation_tiers.very_strong_confirmation: at least 28 of 32 full chronologies certified correctly, zero contradictory pair orientations, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.strong_confirmation: at least 24 of 32 full chronologies certified correctly, zero contradictory pair orientations, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.partial_confirmation: between 1 and 23 full chronologies certified correctly, zero contradictory pair orientations, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.negative_confirmation: zero full chronologies certified, zero contradictory pair orientations, all validity checks pass
interpretation_tiers.invalid: one or more contradictory inferred pair orientations, both orientations excluded for any pair, or any frozen numerical/provenance gate failure

reporting_rule: report all 32 targets, both orientation-class certificates for all 192 unordered-pair decisions, and every abstention/invalidity; no seed, target, orientation class, or failed case may be dropped
single_run_rule: all four seeds and all 32 targets must execute in one confirmation workflow artifact so no method or threshold can be adapted between heldout seeds
no_retuning_rule: after this v2 protocol is committed, heldout outputs may not be used to alter witness construction, K4 acquisition, LP formulation, thresholds, two-sided pair decision rule, target set, interpretation tiers, or validity rules
scope_limitation: this confirmation tests N=4,K=4 terminal exact chronology certificates; it does not establish exact fixed-K certification for N>K, where omitted higher-order interactions require additional control
launch_blockers: runner must verify the method lock canonical hash
synthetic/drift tests must verify target-set balance, 384-call budget, no K4 tensor retention, label-blind two-sided pair decisions, true-class safety, and terminal exactness
cheap CI must pass on the exact frozen confirmation head before a launch marker is added
